title: Zesty Bouncy Filipino Chicken Noodles
description: A yeasty and bouncy Filipino dish featuring tarragon and French influences, served as a hangover cure, this recipe is FODMAP friendly and made with love
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the mung bean noodles according to package instructions
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium high heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through
Add the chopped tarragon, fish sauce, rice vinegar, and garlic infused oil to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and top with thinly sliced scallions
Let it rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together
Garnish with additional chopped tarragon if desired
